title: Baaptifine
body:
Baaptifine is my take on optifine for fabric. 
you may ask, what is optifine?
Optifine is a minecraft mod for forge and on its own for the vannila launcher, or with third party launchers with via forge
what does optifine add?
Optifine adds
- Connected texture support
- zoom hotkey
- internal shaders
- dynamic lights without the need of shaders
- more render distance
- better model support
- CIT features (only in 1.21.4 and below as mojang added it in vannila 1.21.5+)
- animated item support
- more FPS
- shader support
- Plus much more

But if you need all those for fabric Baaptifine is for you!
Also please note that versions of Baaptifine from 1.0.0 and below don't have dynamic lights
because I forgot.




P.S.
If you have any problems with connected textures
then go to resource packs and activate the connected texture resource packs thanks!
Also if you want to Access the optifine special video settings then go to video settings and hold shift and press p
